people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

translations.web: Yahweh’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;
translations.bsb: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
translations.kjv: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
translations.asv: The trees of Jehovah are filled with moisture, The cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
